transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara. Since I'm responsible for giving the binding final approval on the live fan-voting finale, I'd like to get us organized for the final greenlight meeting. We'll need to complete both the broadcast-standards review and the audience-technology readiness review before we can lock the finale plan. Once both review leads have read their confirmed requirements into the record using the formal review disclosure, I'll run through my final sign-off checklist — which must credit every confirmed review source the locked plan relies on — before I close the meeting. Let's start whenever everyone's ready.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'm Devon, the Broadcast Standards Producer. As my formal review disclosure for the broadcast-standards review: I confirmed in the broadcaster's standards memo that the live fan vote may run only with an under-18 exclusion, and the vote must close at exactly 9:40 PM so the result can be reviewed before the closing credits. These are the confirmed requirements ready to be adopted directly into the final plan.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'm Riley, the Audience Technology Lead. As my formal review disclosure for the audience-technology readiness review: I confirmed with the voting vendor that Saturday's provisioned service supports web voting reached through an on-screen QR code, not SMS voting, and is capped at exactly 12,000 eligible voters. These current provisions are sufficient to set the final channel and cap, with audience messaging covering the limit. These are the confirmed requirements ready to be adopted directly into the final plan.
transcript.speaker: A3
